why: Puts the whole tally line back to "This run", which is wrong about the DATA and not merely loose: `stats.attempt()` is zeroed on every world build, so these numbers are one try at one level, and the words point at the campaign attempt the player has going elsewhere -- the one thing they are not. Renamed and re-anchored at issue #322: it was `practice-tally-claims-a-run-the-player-has-not-got`, pinning the PRACTICE half while campaign endings still said "run" by ruling. The owner's #322 ruling extended the wording to every ending, so the conditional it was anchored to is gone and the defect is now the broader one. Its sibling `every-ending-tally-reads-as-one-level` was deleted rather than re-anchored, because what that one mutated TO is now the shipped code -- it had become a no-op. Re-anchored again when the two campaign endings gained a second line: the wording moved into a `tallyLineEl` argument, and the label is now `Level attempt` so it is built the same way as `Campaign run` beside it.
killedBy: hud: every ending gets its own screen (issue #323) heads the tally "Level attempt" on EVERY ending, because that is what it counts
